  WARNING   input  TLS 1.2 AES-CBC cipher suite negotiated [tls.cbc_cipher_negotiated]
            The handshake negotiated a TLS 1.2 cipher suite that uses AES in CBC mode with HMAC-SHA1. Trustsmith's modern probe policy does not offer these suites; this one was available only because the compatible policy was selected explicitly. This describes the parameters of this one handshake, not the endpoint as a whole or other clients' connections.
            Evidence: tls_version=TLS 1.2; cipher_suite=TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_AES_128_CBC_SHA; policy=compatible-v1
            Fix: If the server should serve modern clients, enable TLS 1.3, or TLS 1.2 ECDHE suites with AES-GCM or ChaCha20-Poly1305.
